name: year
description: Reference year of the quarterly observation

name: quarter
description: Reference quarter of the observation, from 1 to 4
observations: ABS labels each quarter by its final month (Q1 March, Q2 June, Q3 September, Q4 December)

name: geography_level
description: Geographic level of the row, either state or australia
observations: australia marks the national aggregate, which is not a state and therefore carries a null state_id; state marks one of the eight states and territories

name: state_id
description: Code of the Australian state or territory
observations: Null on national (australia) rows, which are not a state

name: region_name
description: Name of the state, territory or national aggregate as published by the ABS

name: sex
observations: Male, Female or Persons; series that ABS does not break down by sex are reported as Persons, which is what they count

name: measure
description: Demographic measure reported by the series
observations: Includes estimated_resident_population, natural_increase, net_overseas_migration, net_interstate_migration, births, deaths and the interstate and overseas movement flows

name: unit
description: Unit the value is published in
observations: Persons or Number for the state-level series, 000 for the Australia-only series ABS publishes in thousands, and Percent for the percentage change series. Where the same measure was published in both thousands and persons, the persons figure is kept

name: series_id
description: ABS series identifier of the observation
observations: Foreign key to the au_abs_population series table

name: value
description: Observed value of the series for the quarter
observations: Unit varies by row and is given by the unit column, so no fixed measurement unit is set here
